title: 一道菜带火一座城②淄博烧烤：民宿一夜暴涨865%，小饼卷一切 | One Dish One Town P2 · Zibo BBQ 🍢
description:
淄博的小饼，你会卷烤串、卷小葱，还是卷一切？评论区说说。

【一道菜带火一座城·第2集 淄博烧烤】2023年五一，山东淄博靠一顿烧烤一夜爆红。招牌吃法就俩字——小饼：小饼卷烤串、卷小葱、卷蘸料，炉子端上桌，自己边烤边卷。那个五一，淄博火车站发送旅客24万人次（较2019年+55%），五一民宿预订量较2019年暴涨800%以上（山东最高增速），到店的八成是90后、00后；两个月里全网相关信息超143万条。沙县用了几十年，淄博只用了一个五一——这一次，带火一座城的是社交网络。

Ep.2 Zibo. In May 2023 a single barbecue style set a Shandong city on fire. The trick is a little flatbread — wrap the skewers, the scallions, the dip, and grill it at your own table. Over that holiday Zibo's station moved 240,000 travelers (+55% vs 2019), homestay bookings leapt 800%+ over 2019, 80% of diners were under 35, and the topic drew 1.43M posts in two months. Shaxian took decades; Zibo took one holiday — this time the thing that lit the city was social media.

AI-assisted edit; the bilingual subtitles are the narration — no voiceover. Facts checked this run; sources below. Food & travel note, not investment advice. Footage licensed from Pexels (credited below).
